description: Old tests that wrote FUT/FOP ledgers through the shared engine. P0 freezes those ledgers, so each test was converted to a rejection check or narrowed. The economic vectors are kept here so P3/P6 can re-assert them against the standalone FOP engine instead of dropping them silently. P6 checks every entry against the tests and vectors named in coveredBy before the old FUT/FOP/ROLL branches leave the stock modules.
